tickets.title: Coordinate IRA transfer address exception
tickets.text: Coordinate with Paper Otter Retirement Services and Velvet Acorn Custody to resolve the rejected IRA rollover for Selma Copperwisp, where the former Silver Marmot Robotics 401(k) plan address differed from her current residential address.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate the exception by August 25, 2026.

tickets.title: Resolve joint account registration mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the registration mismatch on the joint taxable account transfer for Selma and Graham Copperwisp, where the transfer paperwork listed joint tenants with rights of survivorship but the Clockwork Clover Brokerage statement shows tenancy by entirety registration.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the mismatch by August 22, 2026.

tickets.title: Resolve duplicate receiving account shell
tickets.text: Resolve the duplicate temporary taxable account shells created for Selma Copperwisp at Velvet Acorn Custody, ensuring Clockwork Clover Brokerage associates the pending ACATS request with the correct shell.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the duplicate shell issue by August 23, 2026.

tickets.title: Handle Copper Firefly manual transfer
tickets.text: Coordinate the manual transfer of the $180,000 Copper Firefly Semiconductors position in Selma Copperwisp's individual brokerage at Clockwork Clover Brokerage outside the standard ACATS feed during the current processing window.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to handle it by August 28, 2026.

tickets.title: Adjust cash holdback on ACATS transfer
tickets.text: Adjust the ACATS instruction for Selma Copperwisp's individual brokerage at Clockwork Clover Brokerage to retain cash for property tax and estimated tax payments normally funded from that account, coordinated with Lena Bramblequill of Polka Fern Tax.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the cash holdback by August 21, 2026.
